item.title: Sanofi CNPV Fast Track Exit
item.description:
• Summary: Sanofi has requested to exit the controversial CNPV fast track program, according to a report from STAT. The decision reflects ongoing strategic adjustments by the company to optimize its regulatory and development pathways.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma

item.title: Sanofi Teplizumab FDA Voucher
item.description:
• Summary: Sanofi has asked the FDA to withdraw its diabetes drug teplizumab from the agency's voucher program, as reported by STAT News. Teplizumab is an anti-CD3 monoclonal antibody approved for delaying the onset of type 1 diabetes.
  • MoAs: Anti-CD3 monoclonal antibody that modulates immune response by targeting CD3 on T cells, thereby reducing autoimmune destruction of pancreatic beta cells.
  • Sources: STAT News

item.title: Ipsen Liver Disease Candidates
item.description:
• Summary: Ipsen has decided to discontinue development of liver disease candidates acquired through its $952 million acquisition of Albireo. The move indicates a strategic pivot away from certain hepatology assets.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Biotech

item.title: Bayer Cell and Gene Therapy Trust
item.description:
• Summary: Bayer is launching initiatives to build trust in cell and gene therapies, as detailed in a Fierce Pharma report. The company aims to address patient and physician confidence through education and transparency.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma

item.title: Lilly Indiana Manufacturing Investment
item.description:
• Summary: Eli Lilly plans a new $4.5 billion manufacturing investment in Indiana, as reported by both Endpoints News and Fierce Pharma. The expansion underscores Lilly's commitment to scaling production capacity for its growing portfolio.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News, Fierce Pharma

item.title: BeOne Cancer and Autoimmune Programs
item.description:
• Summary: BeOne has decided to discontinue five cancer programs and one autoimmune Phase 2 study, according to Endpoints News. The pipeline reduction reflects a strategic reprioritization of resources.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: Lonza ADC Factory Expansion
item.description:
• Summary: Lonza is planning to expand its antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) manufacturing facility and workforce, as reported by Endpoints News. The expansion aims to capitalize on the growing demand for ADCs.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: Bayer Perfuse Deal
item.description:
• Summary: Bayer has announced a deal to acquire Perfuse Therapeutics for up to $2.45 billion, ending a multi-year M&A drought. The deal includes $300 million upfront for a midphase eye disease prospect targeting glaucoma and diabetic retinopathy. The acquisition adds a novel therapeutic candidate to Bayer's ophthalmology pipeline, with potential to address significant unmet needs in retinal diseases.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: BioPharma Dive, BioSpace, Fierce Biotech, Endpoints News

item.title: Amgen/Sanofi North American Expansions
item.description:
• Summary: Amgen and Sanofi have committed nearly $600 million to expand their manufacturing and research facilities in North America. These investments are aimed at increasing production capacity and supporting pipeline development, reflecting a broader trend of biopharma reshoring and capacity expansion in the region.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: BioSpace

item.title: Cytospire Backers Buy Pfizer Exits
item.description:
• Summary: Backers of Cytospire have acquired assets that Pfizer previously exited. This transaction involves Pfizer divesting certain programs or facilities, which are being acquired by Cytospire’s investors to further Cytospire’s pipeline. The deal highlights the recycling of pharma assets into smaller biotechs.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: ApexOnco

item.title: Madrigal Rezdiffra and Gilead Job Cuts
item.description:
• Summary: Madrigal's Rezdiffra (resmetirom) for NASH beat estimates, while Gilead announced job cuts.
  • MoAs: Rezdiffra is a thyroid hormone receptor beta agonist.
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: Former Orbital Scientists mRNA Startup
item.description:
• Summary: Former scientists from Orbital launched a new mRNA therapy startup.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: Avalo Phase 2 Success and Fundraise
item.description:
• Summary: Avalo Therapeutics reported Phase 2 success for its lead candidate and raised $375M to advance development. The win reignites interest from AbbVie despite placebo headwinds.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News, Fierce Biotech

item.title: CellCentric Series D Fundraise
item.description:
• Summary: CellCentric secured $220M in Europe's largest private biotech fundraise of 2026 to advance its multiple myeloma pill inobrodib to market.
  • MoAs: Inobrodib is a BET domain inhibitor.
  • Sources: BioSpace, Endpoints News, BioPharma Dive

item.title: GSK China siRNA Deal
item.description:
• Summary: GSK has entered a $1 billion deal with Chinese biotech Siranbio to develop an siRNA-based therapy targeting abdominal fat reduction, entering the obesity space previously explored by Arrowhead. The partnership involves upfront and milestone payments, reflecting GSK's push into RNA therapeutics for metabolic diseases.
  • MoAs: RNA interference (siRNA) to silence expression of a gene involved in adiposity and fat metabolism.
  • Sources: Endpoints News, Fierce Biotech

item.title: Pfizer/Lilly Q1 and FDA CBER Director
item.description:
• Summary: This roundup covers Pfizer and Eli Lilly's first-quarter earnings, the FDA's appointment of an acting director for the Center for Biologics Evaluation and Research (CBER), and emerging developments in ALS research. The earnings reflect ongoing market dynamics in oncology, diabetes, and beyond.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: BioSpace

item.title: Novo Nordisk Q1 Pills Pricing Payments
item.description:
• Summary: Novo Nordisk's first-quarter earnings highlighted strong sales of oral semaglutide (Rybelsus), pricing strategies amid competitive pressure, and increased scrutiny from payers. The results underscore the company's dominance in the GLP-1 market but also point to upcoming pricing and reimbursement challenges.
  • MoAs: Oral semaglutide: GLP-1 receptor agonist.
  • Sources: Endpoints News
